# Glossary — the ubiquitous language, generated

*Generated by `node tools/gen-glossary` from `spec/00` §0.2, `spec/03` AGSC-03-01, `spec/11` and `ontology/agsc.ttl`. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. Rules win over this page.*

## 1. Terms of the specification (spec/00 §0.2)

- **Bundle** — one directory tree of Markdown items plus exactly one `agsc.config.json`; the unit of publication and of conformance. *(AGSC-00-04)*
- **Item** — one `.md` file with YAML frontmatter whose `type` is one of `concept`, `episode`, `procedure`, `lesson`, `cluster`, `gate`. "Item" is a term of this specification only; no common superclass exists in the ontology (§05). *(AGSC-00-05)*
- **Concept** (with a `kind` qualifier), **Episode**, **Procedure**, **Lesson**, **Cluster**, **Gate** are the six item types. **Link**, **Source**, **Proposal**, **Review**, **Bundle**, **Harness** complete the ubiquitous language; Proposal and Review have no file (they are a forge pull request and its `verified[]` evidence), Source is an inline `sources[]` entry, and a Harness is generated output only. *(AGSC-00-06)*
- **NOW** is generated context, never an item and never hand-edited. *(AGSC-00-07)*
- **Card**, **page**, **deck** and **note** are UI or import vocabulary; they MUST NOT appear as a `type`, a schema key or an ontology term. *(AGSC-00-08)*
- (added at rc.4) **Agent lane** and **live board** complete the language for Mode 5. An **agent lane** is the OPTIONAL, configured capability by which a model-driven or programmatic agent creates, edits, reviews and updates items non-deterministically — always as Proposals, never as writes (AGSC-01-36, AGSC-08-28…30). A **live board** is a Bundle used as the shared working memory and pull-based task board of people and agents, local or remote: work is pulled by whoever claims a task, at most `max_claims` at a time, until the board is done (AGSC-10-16…18). The name says what it is — a board that is live, shared and always current; its operating discipline is Kanban's pull with a work-in-progress limit, and the blackboard architectural pattern (Hayes-Roth 1985, Nii 1986 — `docs/RELATED-WORK.md`) is its lineage (named *Blackboard* on 2026-09-17 and *Kanban* on 2026-09-18, D88; **live board** by the owner's decisions D91 and D96, 2026-09-18). Neither adds a `type`, an item key or an ontology term; both are realised entirely with the objects §0.2 already names. *(AGSC-00-19)*
- (added at rc.4) **Declared scope by version.** The whole of this specification's scope is named here with the version at which each part becomes normative, so that a reader of any version sees the whole and a conforming tool never claims more than its version specifies. **1.0** (normative in this document): the Bundle and the six item types (§1, §2), the fourteen Links (§3), canonical forms (§4), the graph (§5), the surfaces (§6), composition and the Harness (§7), governance with the agent lane (§8), conformance (§9), Levels 0–3, project mode and Mode 5 (§10), the boundary with federation, the plugin contract, visibility, the declaration-only surfaces `responder`, `solid` and `a2a-card`, retirement and tombstones (§11). **1.1** (MINOR, AGSC-00-14 — keys, values and vectors added, nothing removed): the served `responder` (AGSC-11-21), the `memory://` resolver (AGSC-05-04a), `build.rdfxml` (AGSC-01-18), the typed cross-node Link `peer-ref`, a registered short relation if IANA grants one, the `agsc-profile-encrypted` and signatures profiles, the incremental build and the memory pack, i18n variants (AGSC-01-13a served), the benchmark kit, the red-team suite and the public conformance page. **2.0** (MAJOR): servers — a hosted responder, live Agent2Agent boards (AGSC-10-14), a forge application for browser proposals — the Solid pod written by the node rather than only declared (AGSC-11-21), IPFS snapshots and ActivityPub delivery as further declared surfaces (`x-` extensions until then), CRDT live sync, a SPARQL endpoint, hosted multi-tenant nodes. A 1.0 tool MUST accept every declaration a 1.0 rule already admits for these (the `surfaces[]` entries of AGSC-11-16, `build.rdfxml`, the `memory://` alias), MUST NOT emit or claim what a later version specifies, and MUST report an unknown key as `AGSC-E004` as today; `docs/PLAN.md` carries the same list with dates and is informative. *(AGSC-00-20)*

## 2. The fourteen Link keys (AGSC-03-01)

`related` · `broader` · `narrower` · `uses` · `requires` · `excludes` · `derived-from` · `contradicts` · `supersedes` · `implements` · `verifies` · `covers` · `blocked-by` · `decided-by`

Core nine carry composition semantics (spec/03 §3.5); the Mode-2 five (`implements`, `verifies`, `covers`, `blocked-by`, `decided-by`) are navigational and provenance edges. Inverses are computed, never authored (spec/03 §3.2).

## 3. Vocabulary terms (ontology/agsc.ttl, CC0)

| Term | Kind | Label | Domain → Range / Super-class | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asc:Attachment` | Class | Attachment | ⊑ `prov:Entity` | A media file carried by an item under content/attachments/<slug>/ (AGSC-02-98); IRI <item-IRI>#attachment-<n> (AGSC-05-29). Pattern images are SVG only. |
| `asc:Bundle` | Class | Bundle | ⊑ `skos:ConceptScheme` | One directory tree of items published together; the concept scheme every Concept is in. |
| `asc:Cluster` | Class | Cluster | ⊑ `skos:Collection` | A navigational grouping of items. Membership is skos:member, authored on the item. Cluster nesting is also skos:member — never skos:broader, which would put a Collection in a semantic relation. |
| `asc:Concept` | Class | Concept | ⊑ `skos:Concept` | A unit of knowledge in a Bundle: a pattern, taxonomy, explainer, principle, decision, spec, task, term or (rc.3) architecture, distinguished by asc:kind. |
| `asc:Episode` | Class | Episode | ⊑ `prov:Activity` | A recorded occurrence — a session, run or incident — with a start, an actor and an outcome. |
| `asc:Gate` | Class | Gate | ⊑ `prov:Plan` | A declared set of checks that a change must pass; its runs are Episodes. |
| `asc:Harness` | Class | Harness | ⊑ `prov:Plan` | A generated bundle of files assembled from a validated composition of Concepts; never authored, never stored under content/. |
| `asc:Lesson` | Class | Lesson | ⊑ `asc:Concept` | Knowledge distilled from one or more Episodes, carrying a severity; a Concept by essence. |
| `asc:Procedure` | Class | Procedure | ⊑ `prov:Plan` | An executable-by-a-reader plan: trigger, steps and checks. Exports one-to-one to a skill file. |
| `asc:Proposal` | Class | Proposal | ⊑ `prov:Activity` | A proposed change to a Bundle. It has no file: it is a forge pull request, instantiated in exports from the derived git log. |
| `asc:Review` | Class | Review | ⊑ `prov:Activity` | The human assessment of a Proposal. It has no file: it is instantiated from a verified[] entry at the IRI <item-IRI>#review-<n>, its actor and instant carried by asc:verifiedBy and asc:verifiedAt (AGSC-05-15). |
| `asc:Source` | Class | Source | ⊑ `prov:Entity` | An external work cited by an item. It has no file: it is instantiated from a sources[] entry. |
| `asc:blockedBy` | ObjectProperty | blocked by | — → — | Mode-2 key 13: the subject cannot proceed until the object is resolved. No domain, range or super-property (AGSC-05-26a). Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:blocks` | ObjectProperty | blocks | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:blockedBy; never authored. |
| `asc:consumes` | DatatypeProperty | consumes | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | A port type name this item consumes (AGSC-02-96, AGSC-05-30). |
| `asc:contradicts` | ObjectProperty | contradicts | — → — | Asserts that two items cannot both be true. Selecting both in a composition is a warning, never a failure. No domain or range is declared: any item type may author this key, and declaring asc:Concept would entail a Concept typing for Procedures, Episodes and Gates (D48, V1-28). |
| `asc:coveredBy` | ObjectProperty | covered by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:covers; never authored. |
| `asc:covers` | ObjectProperty | covers | — → — | Mode-2 key 12: the subject covers the object (a test, a check or a document covering a requirement). Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:decidedBy` | ObjectProperty | decided by | — → — | Mode-2 key 14: the subject was settled by the object, a decision item. Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:decides` | ObjectProperty | decides | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:decidedBy; never authored. |
| `asc:excludes` | ObjectProperty | excludes | — → — | Asserts mutual exclusion. Evaluated after the requires closure; a surviving pair invalidates a composition. No domain or range is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts. |
| `asc:generatedAt` | DatatypeProperty | generated at | — → `xsd:dateTime` | Instant at which an item was generated, with an explicit UTC offset. |
| `asc:generatedBy` | DatatypeProperty | generated by | — → `xsd:string` | Actor string that generated an item: human:<id>, process:<id> or <producer>/<version>. |
| `asc:grade` | DatatypeProperty | grade | `asc:Source` → `xsd:string` | Evidence grade of a Source: primary, secondary or tertiary. |
| `asc:hasAttachment` | ObjectProperty | has attachment | — → `asc:Attachment` | Links an item to one of its attachments (AGSC-05-29). No domain: items share no superclass (AGSC-05-13). |
| `asc:implementedBy` | ObjectProperty | implemented by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:implements; never authored. |
| `asc:implements` | ObjectProperty | implements | — → — | Mode-2 key 10: the subject realises the object (code or a procedure realising a spec). Combiner semantics: none. |
| `asc:isVerifiedBy` | ObjectProperty | is verified by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:verifies; never authored. Distinct from the datatype property asc:verifiedBy (AGSC-05-15). |
| `asc:kind` | DatatypeProperty | kind | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | Qualifier on a Concept: pattern, taxonomy, explainer, principle, decision, spec, task, term or (rc.3) architecture. |
| `asc:level` | DatatypeProperty | level | `asc:Gate` → `xsd:string` | Gate level: L1 (schema and links) or L2 (adds provenance, determinism and review). |
| `asc:mentions` | ObjectProperty | mentions | — → — | Untyped edge produced by an inline Markdown link between items. Not a Link key; it may not appear in frontmatter. |
| `asc:model` | DatatypeProperty | model | — → `xsd:string` | Model identifier recorded when an item's origin is ai-assisted or ai-generated. |
| `asc:operator` | DatatypeProperty | operator | — → `xsd:string` | Actor accountable for an item: the human or organisation running the agent that produced it. |
| `asc:origin` | DatatypeProperty | origin | — → `xsd:string` | How an item came to exist: human, ai-assisted, ai-generated or imported. |
| `asc:outcome` | DatatypeProperty | outcome | `asc:Episode` → `xsd:string` | Result of an Episode: success, partial or failure. |
| `asc:peerOrigin` | ObjectProperty | peer origin | — → — | The Bundle IRI of the declared peer node under whose base a cited resource lives (AGSC-11-12). Emitted beside rdfs:seeAlso; takes part in no composition step. No range is declared: the object is a foreign node's Bundle IRI about which this node asserts no class (AGSC-05-23). |
| `asc:produces` | DatatypeProperty | produces | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | A port type name this item produces (AGSC-02-96, AGSC-05-30); matched by exact equality in composition Step 5 (AGSC-07-23). |
| `asc:retiredAt` | DatatypeProperty | retired at | — → `xsd:dateTime` | The instant at which an item entered status retired (AGSC-11-22): modified, else date, by the midnight convention of AGSC-05-14, as xsd:dateTime. |
| `asc:review` | ObjectProperty | review | — → `asc:Review` | Connects an item to each asc:Review instantiated from its verified[] entries (AGSC-05-15), so a Review is reachable from its item without string-parsing a fragment IRI. No domain is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts (AGSC-05-13: no asc:Item superclass). |
| `asc:severity` | DatatypeProperty | severity | `asc:Lesson` → `xsd:string` | Weight of a Lesson: info, warn or block. |
| `asc:sha256` | DatatypeProperty | SHA-256 | `asc:Attachment` → `xsd:string` | Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the attachment bytes at build (AGSC-05-29). |
| `asc:source` | ObjectProperty | source | — → `asc:Source` | Connects an item to each asc:Source instantiated from its sources[] entries (AGSC-05-14), so a Source is reachable from its item without string-parsing a fragment IRI. No domain is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts (AGSC-05-13: no asc:Item superclass). |
| `asc:specVersion` | DatatypeProperty | spec version | `asc:Bundle` → `xsd:string` | Version of the AgenticSystemCore specification a Bundle declares. |
| `asc:staleAfter` | DatatypeProperty | stale after | — → `xsd:dateTime` | Absolute instant after which an item is stale. Staleness is a comparison, never a decay function. |
| `asc:status` | DatatypeProperty | status | — → `xsd:string` | Publication state of an item: draft, stable, deprecated or (rc.3) retired (AGSC-11-22). |
| `asc:taskState` | DatatypeProperty | task state | `asc:Concept` → `xsd:string` | One of the nine Agent2Agent 1.0 task states, verbatim (AGSC-02-99, AGSC-10-13). |
| `asc:usedBy` | ObjectProperty | used by | — → — | Computed inverse of asc:uses; never authored. No domain or range is declared, for the reason given on asc:contradicts. |
| `asc:uses` | ObjectProperty | uses | — → — | Soft dependency: the subject draws on the object. A composition warns when a used item is absent. No domain, range or super-property is declared: skos:related is a sub-property of skos:semanticRelation, whose domain and range are skos:Concept (S19/S20), so a super-property axiom would re-introduce the unintended Concept typing and the S37 contradiction for Clusters (AGSC-05-26a, V3-06). |
| `asc:verifiedAt` | DatatypeProperty | verified at | `asc:Review` → `xsd:dateTime` | Instant at which a human recorded a Review, with an explicit UTC offset. |
| `asc:verifiedBy` | DatatypeProperty | verified by | `asc:Review` → `xsd:string` | Actor string of the human who recorded a Review. |
| `asc:verifiedOn` | DatatypeProperty | verified on | `asc:Source` → `xsd:dateTime` | Instant at which a Source was last checked to resolve; an authored YYYY-MM-DD date is rendered as that day's midnight UTC instant. xsd:date is not in the OWL 2 datatype map, so xsd:dateTime keeps the ontology inside OWL 2 RL (AGSC-05-14, AGSC-05-22). |
| `asc:verifies` | ObjectProperty | verifies | — → — | Mode-2 key 11: the subject checks that the object holds. Its computed inverse is asc:isVerifiedBy (the datatype property asc:verifiedBy carries a Review actor and is unrelated). Combiner semantics: none. |

## 4. Boundary vocabulary (spec/11)

- **Surface** — an agent-facing entry a node serves and declares: `llms-txt`, `chunks`, `mcp`, `webmcp`, `a2a-card`, `solid`, `responder` (AGSC-11-16).
- **Access class** — what a reader needs before invoking a surface: `none`, `consent`, `credential` (AGSC-11-16).
- **Visibility** — `public` or `restricted` (AGSC-11-20); the discovery document is readable at both.
- **Contribute mode** — `pr`, `channel` or `form` (AGSC-11-14): where a proposal from anyone goes.
- **Peer** — another node named by its canonical well-known URL (AGSC-11-06); checked mutually, never fetched at build.
- **Walk** — a client-side traversal of peers bounded by `hop_limit`, `fan_out` and `max_requests` (AGSC-11-10).
- **Origin marking** — every peer-derived result carries `trust: untrusted` and the peer Bundle IRI (AGSC-11-11).
- **Tombstone** — the state of a node that stopped publishing: a valid link set with `agsc-tombstone` (AGSC-11-23).
- **Retired** — an item status that keeps the IRI and page and leaves every export (AGSC-11-22).
- **Plugin contract** — declare · pin · inherit · prove (AGSC-11-16…19).
